buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Due to tender on GeM portal and its probable constraint(s), GAIL is floating the current Tender [Ref. No. GA IL/KRKL26-17/PIPELINE/ROU/BBA] through following 04 GeM Bids GEM/2026/B/8225979 Group 1 - ARC FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND ROU MAINTENANCE AT Adiyakkama ngalam Region GEM/2026/B/8225990 Group 2 - ARC FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND ROU MAINTENANCE AT Ramnad Re gion GEM/2026/B/8225994 Group 3 - ARC FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND ROU MAINTENANCE AT Kuthalam R egion GEM/2026/B/8225998 Group 4 - ARC FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND ROU MAINTENANCE AT Narimanam Region Bidder may submit their bid against one Bid or all 04 Bids or any combination thereof on least cost to GAIL concept basis based on their available credentials towards proof of meeting BEC (Technical as well as Fina ncial). Further, if n bidder happens to be lowest in more than one Group(s) and has qualified only for one o r more than one of the Group(s) and not all Group(s), as the case may be, the entire work shall be finalized on least cost to GAIL basis. In such case, the L1 bidder shall get the order for Group(s) (subject to meeting the technical and financial criteria for respective Group(s)]. Once certain Group(s) are awarded to such L-1 bidder, the bidder ceases to be lowest bidder for the remaining Group(s). Bidders may submit complete BEC documents/Formats against each such quoted GeM Bid(s). In case of size constraint, bidder may upload common/some documents in any one quoted GeM Bid. Howe ver, GAIL shall download documents submitted by a bidder against all such quoted GeM bid(s) and evaluat ion & award shall be done by treating all above mentioned GeM Bids as a single Tender. Thus, cumulative experience / BEC criteria shall be applicable. Therefore, bidders are required to go through all these GeM Bid Documents and submit their bid according ly. The documents such as a) Bid Evaluation Criteria b) General Conditions of Contract c) Special Condition s of Contract and d) Scope of Work, in addition to Sector specific Documents, as submitted by a bidder in a particular GeM Bid(s) shall be considered for evaluation and award, and also shall form integral part of all t he Tender/Contract (LOA). GAIL is floating the Tender as custom bid on Group wise basis and bidders are asked to quote the Lumpsu m amount against each Group. The breakup of the Lumpsum amount quoted against each Group shall be submitted along with the price bid (Document along with financial bid) as per the Schedule of Rates (SOR) format attached with the tender exactly matching the total Lumpsum amount quoted in GeM portal. Important Note: Sequence for submitting Financial Bid: i) The bidder shall download the Schedule of Rates (SOR) file available in Excel format on the GeM Bid.

ii) The bidder shall quote item wise unit rate for all the SOR items Group Wise, in the Excel File, and the Tot al Amount including GST as per the Excel File shall be Quoted in the GeM portal against Financial Bid. iii) A PDF file of the duly filled in Excel file with Unit Rate and Amount shall be generated and uploaded aga inst the Financial Bid. . 2.
